skills.name: CSV Data Handler
skills.description: Generate, parse, filter, and transform CSV files using pandas. Handles UTF-8 with BOM for Excel compatibility, custom delimiters, and quoted fields. Output saved to the workspace.
skills.short_description: Create and transform CSV files with pandas.

skills.name: Word Document Generator
skills.description: Generate DOCX reports, letters, and contracts with full Unicode support (Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Hebrew) using python-docx. Output saved to the workspace.
skills.short_description: Create multilingual Word documents with tables and images.

skills.name: Markdown Document Converter
skills.description: Convert Markdown files to styled PDF or HTML documents with code highlighting, tables, and RTL support using markdown-it and Playwright. Output saved to the workspace.
skills.short_description: Convert Markdown to styled PDF or HTML.

skills.name: PDF Document Generator
skills.description: Generate PDF reports, invoices, and certificates with full support for Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and Russian using Playwright. Output saved to the workspace.
skills.short_description: Create multilingual PDFs with charts and images.

skills.name: PowerPoint Presentation Generator
skills.description: Generate PPTX presentations with layouts, bullet points, tables, charts, and images using python-pptx. Supports Arabic RTL slides, CJK, and Russian. Output saved to the workspace.
skills.short_description: Create PowerPoint decks with layouts, bullets, and charts.

skills.name: Excel Spreadsheet Generator
skills.description: Generate XLSX spreadsheets with formulas, styling, charts, and conditional formatting using openpyxl. Supports Arabic RTL sheets, CJK, and Russian. Output saved to the workspace.
skills.short_description: Create Excel workbooks with formulas, formatting, and RTL sheets.
